fit_reason: Although posted under cars by owner, this reads as dealer stock: a former utility fleet bucket truck with a dealer website video tour link, shipping offers, and dealer-style sales copy. It is not a typical private-owner sale.
findings: White cab and fiberglass utility body look clean and glossy in all exterior shots
Black bumper, grille and fender flares on the front look reasonably dark, not badly faded
Compartment interiors show bare wood shelving with normal wear, nothing a detail would meaningfully change
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the F-450 bucket truck. The white cab and utility body already look clean and sharp in the photos. If you ever want a pre-sale interior detail or trim refresh on this or other units, we come to you and are happy to give a quote.
